$comment: ANA feature manifest. Each feature lists the skill that ports it, standalone modules to copy as-is, and anchors: strings that exist in the code once the feature is in. skills/ana-update/scripts/ana-diff.mjs searches a target ANA's .js/.html files for these anchors to report present / partial / missing. test.cjs checks that every anchor exists in this repo, so keep them in sync when you rename things.

runtime.note: Shared runtime. Never patch it per ANA. If it differs from upstream, replace the whole file (ask the user first — every ANA on the host shares it).

features.title: Chat window — Claude app layout
features.summary: User bubbles, markdown replies without bubbles, 'Ran 3 commands ›' tool groups, ✳ elapsed-time spinner, floating blurred composer, ↓ jump button with new-message dot, keyboard-fit on iOS.

features.title: Session combo box
features.summary: Full-width, left-aligned agent-session combo in the chat header; popup matches its width; 'You' only on the session this screen views.

features.title: Reliable send state
features.summary: Optimistic bubble → sent → acked (agent started working) → confirmed; handles [Pasted text] echoes so delivered messages never show Unconfirmed/Resend.

features.title: Structured chat log (Claude Code + Codex)
features.summary: Render the chat from the agent's own JSONL log instead of the screen mirror: ~/.claude/projects/<cwd>/*.jsonl for Claude Code, ~/.codex/sessions/**/rollout-*.jsonl for Codex. Real model name in the composer. Opens with the latest 40 items and loads earlier ones 40 at a time as you scroll up (scroll position kept).

features.title: Model & effort picker sheet
features.summary: Tap the model pill → bottom sheet like the Claude app. Claude Code: /model + /effort, result read back from the screen. Codex: model catalog from ~/.codex/models_cache.json, picked through Codex's own menu.

features.title: Permission mode picker (Claude Code + Codex)
features.summary: Model sheet › Permissions shows the agent's current permission mode and switches it. Claude Code: reads the status line and presses Shift+Tab until the wanted mode shows (manual · accept edits · plan · auto · bypass). Codex: /permissions menu (Ask for approval · Approve for me · Full Access) with its extra confirmation. Modes without prompts ask first; System › Safety uses the live mode. A shield icon in the composer shows the mode at a glance (red with "!" when it never asks) and opens a permissions-only sheet.

features.title: Plan usage rings (5-hour · weekly)
features.summary: Two ring charts in the composer that fill as the plan limit is used; tap for % and reset time. Claude: api.anthropic.com/api/oauth/usage with the local login. Codex: rate_limits from its rollout log.

features.title: Voice dictation
features.summary: Mic button using the browser's SpeechRecognition; dictates into the input at the cursor. Hidden when unsupported.

features.title: File attachments
features.summary: ＋ button uploads files to .ana/uploads and sends their paths with the message; images show as thumbnails in the bubble.

features.title: Context chips (Chip mode)
features.summary: Chip toggle; tap any on-screen item to attach it to the next message as a context chip; refresh button rescans the page.

features.title: Draw on screen (annotation)
features.summary: Pen button next to refresh; draw red/magenta/blue marks, then 'Add to chat' attaches an annotated screenshot + the items under the marks. Opens the chat right away on mobile.

features.title: Work graph — notes, tasks, events and their links (NodeRel)
features.summary: Graph › Work: the Work graph — SPAWNED / SCHEDULED_AS / REFERS_TO + derived DUE_ON / ON from the Work ontology (work-ontology.js), indexed with the knowledge graph in NodeRel (graph-index.js → graph-index.sqlite). New link kinds are a lens (stored, shown as new). Relation chips on items, the flow chart, 'where the flow breaks', links by kind.

features.title: Graph › Knowledge › Analyze — the agent finds entities and facts in the work
features.summary: Graph › Knowledge › Analyze: pick notes / tasks / events (and a focus), the agent reads them via /api/analysis/input, reports progress, and posts an ontology (classes with parents, relation types with domain → range) and a knowledge graph (entities with classes, facts with relations, each citing source items). Shown as two views — Ontology and Knowledge graph (force layout, tap an entity for its facts and sources). Results must fit the ontology (entity classes and fact relations exist, facts respect domain → range with sub-classes); misfits are dropped and listed as issues. The ontology accumulates per workspace and seeds the next analysis. The latest knowledge graph is indexed in NodeRel (entities kg:<id>, facts typed by relation, MENTIONED_IN to source items) for /api/graph/neighbors · trace · schema. Exports OWL/Turtle (/api/analysis/ttl) and opens in OntoAir through a 24-hour token link (/api/analysis/shared/<token>/<name>.ttl, CORS).

features.title: Workspace / System scopes
features.summary: Two scopes: Workspace (members: Tasks · Calendar · Notes · Knowledge · Files · Inbox) and System (admin: Inbox · Roadmap · Health, dark header band). On phones a bottom menu per scope (Work · Knowledge · Files · Inbox · System / Inbox · Roadmap · Health · Workspace); the top tab strip shows only for Tasks · Calendar · Notes. Badges: Inbox = what waits on you in this workspace; System = admin inbox + roadmap items to start + checks at risk.

features.title: Workspaces
features.summary: Workspace combo in the header: switch, add, rename, delete, reorder; state isolated per workspace.

features.title: Approvals & Requests (agent → user)
features.summary: Inbox › Approvals: what the agent needs your OK for — pending data-change diffs, analysis results to add to the knowledge graph, plus approval / decision / access requests. Inbox › Action requests: work only you can do (action) and missing information (info). Answer, mark done or dismiss. Lists filter Open · Done. System › Inbox has the same two tabs for the admin (POST /api/admin/requests); every tab has Ask the agent.

features.title: Requirements (user → system) with reflection analysis
features.summary: System › Roadmap › Requirements: the user writes what they want this ANA to do. Analyze has the agent check each requirement against the actual code, dashboard, APIs and data, and report its status (Reflected · Partly · Not reflected), how it is reflected, why not (not built yet, conflicts, needs info, out of scope, blocked), evidence and the next step. Progress bar while running; filter by status; editing a requirement marks its analysis as stale.

features.title: Evolve (agent → app proposals)
features.summary: Inbox › Evolve in both scopes: the agent looks at the app's features, its data and the usage log (/api/activity) and proposes how the system (System › Inbox › Evolve, the admin starts them) or this workspace (Workspace › Inbox › Evolve) should evolve; then the agent implements.

features.title: Trustworthiness · Safety · Security checks
features.summary: System tabs computed from real state by /api/trust: agent running, structured log, tool failure rate, interruptions, plan usage (Trustworthiness); permission-bypass flags, risky commands the agent ran, approval gate (Safety); bind address, sign-in, CSRF, token handling, credential file mode, secrets saved in notes/tasks (Security). Risk count badges System. Shown in System › Health with one sub-tab each — Trustworthiness · Safety · Security · Usage — risk → review → info, OK checks folded.

features.title: Update tab (check upstream, port with the agent)
features.summary: System › Update: Check for updates fetches agent-native-agent into .ana/upstream and runs ana-diff.mjs against this ANA. Each missing or partial feature, newer module and shared-runtime difference becomes an item (Waiting · In progress · Done · Failed · Cancelled). Update sends the agent a porting instruction with the skill, missing anchors and the upstream path; the agent reports done/fail via /api/update-act. Cancelled items stay hidden from later checks.

features.title: Offline edition (no LLM) and Windows package
features.summary: ANA_OFFLINE=1 serves the page with data-offline (agent screens hidden), stops tmux polling and answers 503 on agent/internet routes. scripts/package-offline.mjs builds a portable Windows x64 zip (Node 24 LTS + app + node_modules + start.bat, ANA_OPEN=1).

features.title: Admins and members — System › Admin inbox, Evolve scopes
features.summary: Roles (ANA_ADMINS; single-user = admin). Server gates system actions (system Evolve start/cancel, Update, risky permission modes, workspace delete) with needsAdmin; the page turns them into admin approval requests, executed on approval. System › Admin lists approvals and action requests from members, the agent and system checks (risk → work request). Evolve proposals are system or workspace scoped; workspace ones can be escalated.

features.title: Work and Knowledge ontologies (classes, relations, rules) and knowledge graphs
features.summary: One ontology for the ANA in two layers: the Work layer (work-schema.js — what this app's code stores: classes and relations, explicit or derived; read-only at runtime, changes with the code; graph.js reads its vocabulary from it) and the Knowledge layer (.ana/ontology.json — the work's concepts, curated by the admin in System › Ontology; broken references to concepts that disappeared are reported as issues). One knowledge graph per workspace (kg.json). The ontology is a lens, not a gate: what doesn't fit is kept and marked (fit/why computed on read by kgLens); new or undeclared concepts go to the admin as tidying requests (ontology.add); results are added when a member approves (/api/analysis/apply). Rules (the third part of an ontology) on read: sub-class types, inverse / symmetric / transitive, chain rules (if a path of 1–3 relations, reverse steps allowed, then a relation) → inferred facts with rule and because; limit rules mark facts that break them; Work compute rules (DUE_ON/ON) read-only. Never stored; exported as OWL (subPropertyOf, propertyChainAxiom, maxCardinality). Graph › Work shows the work graph (new link kinds are a lens: stored, shown as new); Graph › Knowledge shows the knowledge graph with Analyze and the latest analysis; the ontology is one page (System › Ontology), with Work · Knowledge tabs (Classes · Relations · Rules inside), read-only for members from Graph › Ontology. Sub-types on work items (POST /api/subtype) and promotion evidence (GET /api/ontology/evidence). /api/kg/ttl exports TBox + ABox.

features.title: Health › Tests
features.summary: Runs the ANA's own tests (package.json scripts.test, node commands only, minimal env, admin only), keeps the last 10 runs with per-suite pass/fail, failing test names and output (tests.json), and counts a failed run on the Health badge.
